title: Octanuclear heterometallic FeIII–CeIV pivalate clusters: From a close {Fe4Ce4(μ4-O)4} cage to an open {Fe4Ce4(μ4-O)2(μ3-O)2} core

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, a MeCN (6 mL) solution of [Fe3O(O2CCMe3)6(H2O)3]O2CCMe3·2(Me3CCO2H) (0.115 g, 0.1 mmol), Ce(NO3)3·6H2O (0.130 g, 0.3 mmol), and sodium azide (0.02 g, 0.3 mmol) was treated with triethanolamine (0.37 g, 2.5 mmol) in MeOH (6 mL). The mixture was ultrasonicated (37 kHz) for 30 min, filtered, and the filtrate was left to evaporate slowly at room temperature. Orange crystals of 1 suitable for X-ray analysis formed after two weeks, were filtered, washed with MeCN, and dried in air.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature (crystallization); ultrasonic irradiation at 37 kHz
synthesis.time: 30 min ultrasonication; crystals after two weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: ultrasonic cleaner (Elmasonic P, 37 kHz); slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered after ultrasonication; filtrate evaporated slowly at room temperature; crystals washed with MeCN and dried in air

properties.summary: Electronic absorption spectra of the FeIII–CeIV clusters show broad LMCT features assigned to CeIV (LMCT → 5d and LMCT → 4f), supporting the CeIV oxidation state; UV–Vis data are presented mainly as SI figures. No magnetic susceptibility or related measurements are reported; high-spin FeIII is inferred from bond lengths rather than magnetometry.

measurements.name: UV–Vis / electronic absorption (LMCT)
measurements.value: broad LMCT → 5d CeIV and LMCT → 4f CeIV features
measurements.conditions: electronic absorption spectra; SI Figs. S7 and S8

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, a MeCN (6 mL) solution of [Fe6O2(OH)2(O2CCMe3)12] (0.04 g, 0.025 mmol), Ce(NO3)3·6H2O (0.07 g, 0.16 mmol), and sodium azide (0.02 g, 0.3 mmol) was treated with triethanolamine (0.37 g, 2.5 mmol) in MeOH (6 mL). The mixture was ultrasonicated (37 kHz) for 30 min, filtered, and the filtrate was left to evaporate slowly at room temperature. Orange crystals of 2 suitable for X-ray analysis were collected after one month, washed with MeCN, and dried in air.

synthesis.time: 30 min ultrasonication; crystals after one month

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered after ultrasonication; slow evaporation of filtrate at room temperature; crystals washed with MeCN and dried in air
